parameters.prompt: The exact large snake in the reference performs ONE heavy ground slam in place. The coils stay on the ground and do not slither. Mouth closed. Keep the same three-quarter left view, scales, colours and head shape. No slithering, turning around, striking across the frame, second attack, extra heads, venom. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint.
